title: Agent records a finding with one command
asA: agent that has just seen a blueprint or rcf-lite misbehave
iWant: to record the finding with a single rcf feedback add call whose flags cover kind, target, anchor, symptom class, severity, title, body and evidence pointers, and to be told nothing was sent
soThat: a finding is captured at the moment I see it, without any user-facing interruption and without any network traffic

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf feedback add with the required flags (--kind, --target, --anchor, --class, --severity, --title, --body or --body-file, --evidence at least once, optional --harness and --ask-now) writes exactly one JSONL line to .rcf/feedback/entries.jsonl, stamps environment (harness, rcf-lite version, node version, platform) on the entry, prints "recorded <id> (<n> pending). Nothing sent." on stdout, and exits 0. No network syscall is made (assertable by a stubbed submit path and by absence of gh calls).
acceptanceCriteria.when: the agent runs rcf feedback add with every required flag
acceptanceCriteria.then: entries.jsonl has one line whose fields match the flags and the environment stamp; stdout carries the "recorded" line; exit code is 0; the network seam has not been touched

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf feedback add refuses when the project .gitignore does not cover .rcf/feedback/ and no --force flag is passed. The error names the missing gitignore entry and points at rcf doctor --fix. Exit code is 2. No file is created under .rcf/feedback/.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project whose .gitignore lacks the .rcf/feedback/ entry
acceptanceCriteria.when: the agent runs rcf feedback add without --force
acceptanceCriteria.then: the command exits 2, stderr names the missing gitignore entry and the rcf doctor --fix remedy, and .rcf/feedback/ is not created

acceptanceCriteria.description: When --kind blueprint is passed and the target cannot be resolved to a known blueprint in rcf/manifest.json:blueprints[], the entry is still recorded with destination: unresolved. Exit code is 3 (usage-plus-outcome), stdout carries the recorded line and stderr carries a one-line "destination unresolved: <target>" note that the agent can relay.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project whose manifest carries no matching blueprint
acceptanceCriteria.when: the agent runs rcf feedback add --kind blueprint --target unknown-slug ...
acceptanceCriteria.then: the entry is written with destination.repo absent and destination.reason set to unresolved; exit code is 3; stderr carries the one-line note

acceptanceCriteria.description: Symptom class must be one of the closed enum (docs-mismatch, validate-fails, apply-fails, internal-contradiction, stale-citation, missing-scenario, verb-error, verb-hang, wrong-output, other). Any other value exits 2 with a usage error naming the enum. Severity must be one of blocker, major, minor. Title is capped at 120 chars, body at 8 KB (either --body or --body-file); over-cap inputs exit 2 with a size error.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project whose gitignore is set up correctly
acceptanceCriteria.when: the agent runs rcf feedback add with an invalid class or severity, an oversize title, or an oversize body
acceptanceCriteria.then: each invalid invocation exits 2, stderr names the specific violation and the enum or size limit; no entry is written
